text: be used in infants and that cyclopentolate should not be used at all during the first 3 months of life. In the treatment of uveitis and iritis, a 0.5% ophthalmic solution of cyclopentolate hydrochloride is instilled into the eye up to four times daily. Deeply pigmented eyes are more resistant to pupillary dilatation and may require the use of a 1% solution.
